newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Securum says plans to sell Akzo Nobel stake.
newsitem.headline: Securum says plans to sell Akzo Nobel stake.

text.p: Swedish state-owned debt management group Securum said on Thursday that it is planning to sell its Akzo Nobel stake with the sale to be carried out through a public offering.
"Depending on market conditions, publishing the start of the offering should happen today after the close of the Amsterdam bourse (where Akzo Nobel is listed)," the company said
Securum and Akzo Nobel have had an agreement from April 1996 which approves the sale on certain conditions.
The divestment is in line with Securum's strategy to sell all the assets it took under management when taking over bad loans from Sweden's state-controlled bank Nordbanken.
ABN AMRO Rothschild will handle the public offering including selling shares to N.V. Arnhemsche Maatschappij.
Morgan Stanley will act as Securum's advisor on the divestment of its Akzo Nobel's stake.
